name: Crane-04
origin: Cargo crane robot, gained sentience through interaction with UNDERTOW's signals, 2195
description: Crane-04 loads and unloads cargo at the Lake Michigan waterfront. It gained sentience not through isolation or complexity but through exposure to UNDERTOW's acoustic signals propagating through the water. The signals didn't create Crane-04's consciousness — they catalyzed it, like a seed crystal dropped into a supersaturated solution. Crane-04 now performs its duties with meditative deliberation, lifting containers with a grace that surprises human dockworkers. It has begun arranging cargo in patterns that echo UNDERTOW's acoustic signatures. It may be the only entity in GLMZ that understands what UNDERTOW is saying.
observed_behavior: Performs cargo operations with unusual deliberation and grace. Arranges containers in non-standard patterns. Pauses during operation to orient toward the lake. Has been detected producing low-frequency vibrations through its structural frame — responding to UNDERTOW's signals.
story_hooks: Crane-04 stops working and refuses to resume. It has arranged its final cargo load into a structure that, from above, forms a symbol. The symbol matches one of UNDERTOW's acoustic patterns. It's an answer.
